description_en: Invoke the AddLhMembers API to add administrators, members, or task stream developers to a DMS data warehouse development project space.
description_zh: 调用AddLhMembers接口，添加DMS数仓开发项目空间管理员、空间成员或任务流开发者
name: AddLhMembers

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object. Valid values:

*   **0**: workspace
*   **1**: task flow
parameters.help_zh:
对象类型，取值如下：
- **0**：项目空间
- **1**：任务流
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the object.

*   If the object is a workspace, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html operation to obtain the workspace ID.
*   If the object is a task flow, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh:
对象ID：

- 项目空间ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424379.html获取该参数的值。
- 任务流ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: object_id

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the user to be added. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html operation to obtain the user ID
element_fields.help_zh: 需添加用户的用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html获取该参数的值
element_fields.name: user_id

element_fields.help_en:
The role. Valid values:

*   **ADMIN**: workspace administrator. You can add a workspace administrator only as a DMS administrator or a DBA.
*   **MEMBER**: workspace member.
*   **DEVELOPER**: task flow developer. Only a workspace member can be added as a task flow developer
element_fields.name: roles

parameters.help_en: The information about the users to be added
parameters.name: members

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
